definition: The lateral corticospinal tract is a tract in the side of the spinal cord, including the cervical region, that can be examined with MRI measures such as diffusion and magnetization transfer. In this study, changes in this tract were assessed as a possible marker of motor neuron degeneration and disease progression in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
